## Key Projects & Research
- **HTML-in-Canvas Lab & Benchmark Suite**: Empirical performance benchmarking and interactive exploration of the WICG HTML-in-Canvas standard (`content="drawable"`, `drawElementImage`, `texElementSubImage2D`, `drawElementImageToTexture`). (URL: https://thehenrylabs.dev/labs/html-in-canvas/)
- **apex-skills**: Token-optimal, empirically verified Agent Skills and deterministic context engine for frontier AI coding agents, slashing cold-start token consumption by 95%. (Repo: https://github.com/thehenrylabsdev/apex-skills)
- **spring-batch-cronjob**: Distributed horizontal CSV partitioning and processing with Spring Batch 6, Java 25, Quartz clustering, PostgreSQL SKIP LOCKED queues, and Kubernetes. (Repo: https://github.com/thehenrylabsdev/spring-batch-cronjob)
